service: The next generation of AWS Resilience Hub is the single location in AWS where you assess and improve the resilience of your critical applications. It helps Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) and development teams proactively reason about resilience at scale — identifying failure modes, discovering hidden dependencies, and report on progress across the enterprise.

operations.CreateAssertion: Creates a resilience assertion for a service.
operations.CreateInputSource: Creates an input source for a service.
operations.CreatePolicy: Creates a resilience policy that defines availability and disaster recovery requirements.
operations.CreateReport: On-demand report creation. Idempotent — duplicate requests with same clientToken return existing result.
operations.CreateServiceFunction: Creates a service function within a service.
operations.CreateSystem: Creates a system that represents a logical grouping of services.
operations.CreateTest: Creates a test for a service by configuring a test template. Each service has one test per template.
operations.CreateUserJourney: Creates a user journey within a system.
operations.DeleteAssertion: Deletes a resilience assertion from a service.
operations.DeleteTestSources: Removes monitoring sources from a test. The operation is transactional and idempotent — removing a source that is not attached is a no-op.
operations.GetTestRun: Retrieves a test run by ID, including its status, results, and the configuration snapshotted when the run started.
operations.GetTestTemplate: Retrieves a resilience test template by ARN, including the parameters it accepts and the fault actions it runs.
operations.ImportApp: Imports a V1 app into the V2 resource model, creating a service with the same name.
operations.ImportPolicy: Imports a V1 policy into V2, mapping RTO/RPO values from V1 scenarios.
operations.ListReports: List reports for a service, or all reports owned by the account if serviceArn is not provided.
operations.ListResolvedTestRunTargetResources: Lists the AWS resources that AWS Fault Injection Service (AWS FIS) resolved as targets for a test run.
operations.ListTestRunEvents: Lists the events in a test run's timeline.
operations.ListTestRunSources: Lists the monitoring source snapshots captured for a test run, optionally filtered by type.
operations.ListTestRuns: Lists the runs of a test, or all test runs for a service.
operations.ListTestSources: Lists the monitoring sources attached to a test, optionally filtered by type.
operations.ListTestTemplates: Lists the available resilience test templates. A test template is a pre-configured, AWS recommended test that defines which resilience capability to validate.
operations.ListTests: Lists the tests configured for a service.
operations.PutTestSources: Adds or updates the monitoring sources on a test. The operation is transactional — either every source is written or the call fails and nothing is written.
operations.StartTestRun: Starts a run of a test. Each run scopes to the current resources in the service and produces a pass or fail outcome.
operations.UpdateTest: Updates the configuration of an existing test.
